testcase.system-out: Scenario: Give quick access and ribbon tabs separate rows ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the quick access toolbar is configured to appear above the ribbon ✔ And the ribbon is docked at the top in its expanded Normal appearance ✔ When the user selects the View ribbon tab ✔ Then quick access remains in the top application bar alongside document context ✔ And File appears at the leading edge of the ribbon tab row beneath that bar ✔ And the ribbon tabs share that row with File ✔ And the selected View tab is visually distinct from the other tabs ✔ And the View command panels occupy a separate row beneath the tabs ✔ And each visible panel title sits below its commands
